Version, date and headline counts for the release in use

Source: R/release.R
release_info.Rd

Version, date and headline counts for the release in use

Usage

release_info(version = "latest")

Arguments

version

Release version, or "latest".

Value

A list describing the release.

Examples

# \donttest{
release_info()
#> $version
#> [1] "1.6.2"
#> 
#> $date
#> [1] "2026-09-01"
#> 
#> $n_studies
#> [1] 38
#>

#>

#>
